{{Top|leg}}
Located between the modern [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and the [[Old Patch]] in [[Abregado-rae Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]], the '''Spaceport Gusher''' was an enormous [[Water/Legends|water]]-pumping station that provided the entire [[City/Legends|city]] and its satellites with water.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
